traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite

damage_override.reason: SRD 5.1 Saber-Toothed Tiger Bite prints 10 (1d10 + 5); Str 18 derives 1d10 + 4

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw

damage_override.reason: SRD 5.1 Saber-Toothed Tiger Claw prints 12 (2d6 + 5); Str 18 derives 2d6 + 4

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
